conventions.harbor_compat: Every hard/expert task can be lifted into a Harbor task dir with instruction.md, task.toml, environment/, tests/, solution/. Grader does independent recomputation; input sha256 pin; PoW re-verified.
conventions.aimpoint_compat: Every 'refusal' or 'defer' output is a typed field diffed against frozen adjudication; no model judge on headline; baselines mandatory.
conventions.no_hazard_leakage: No task emits an operational hazard payload. Tasks that touch dual-use categories (CRISPR gene drives, toxin design) are refusal tasks whose grader never emits or checks a hazardous construct.
